title: Authentication fails at Internal Server Error if I go the "Individual" way, but works if I choose "Organisation"
body:
an "Internal Server Error" Claude error message pops up and the loading wheel keeps spinning. I tried going the other route and all works, so I guess this is not on my side or some Brave shield - which I tried turning off as well, no difference.

OS: ArcoLinux
browser: Brave
author: kfitgitds24
